Scarlet & Violet Arc'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Ryū Matsushima]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It is serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine, with the first three chapters published in the March 2023 issue, released on January 20, 2023. It is the sequel of [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc]]. It tells the story of '''Retto Mirai ''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|未|み}}{{ruby|来|らい}}{{ruby|烈|れっ}}{{ruby|斗|と}}}}''' ''Mirai Retto'') and '''Retto''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|烈|れっ}}{{ruby|人|と}}}}''' ''Retto''). Like its predecessor, this manga is collected into volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームやろうぜ～っ！}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!''). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|始|はじ}}めよう！{{ruby|Ｓ|スカーレット}}{{ruby|＆|アンド}}{{ruby|Ｖ|バイオレット}}！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Let's Start! Scarlet & Violet! Arc'') and (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|輝|かがや}}け！テラスタル！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Shine! Terastal! Arc''). Each volume is 192 pages long. ==Volumes== {| class="roundtable c" style="margin:auto; background:#{{colorschemelight|Paldea}}; border:2px solid #{{colorschemedark|Paldea}}" |- !
